title: A&O Shearman accelerates AI strategy with a USD1.1 billion lawyer-led commitment
summary: A&O Shearman announced a five-year USD1.1 billion AI commitment, primarily through practice time invested in specialist tools and services. Each practice is to devote at least 3% of its time to that development; this is not described as an entirely cash investment.
evidenceQuote: Every practice to invest at least 3% of its time in building specialist AI tools and services for its area of law

title: Linklaters and Legora: bringing a distinctive approach to legal AI
summary: Linklaters reports that 97% of its weekly active Legora users used Agent within the first month of its rollout. The firm describes structured-finance document review and work with Legora on new capabilities, including Skills.
evidenceQuote: Following the rollout of Legora Agent, 97% of weekly active users were using Agent within its first month.

title: Fieldfisher goes firm-wide with Legora across its international network
summary: Fieldfisher announced a Legora rollout to approximately 1,400 lawyers and business-services professionals after a six-week European pilot involving 137 users. Its Berlin AI hub is leading the rollout, with practice-specific workflows and training.
evidenceQuote: Fieldfisher is rolling out AI platform Legora to around 1,400 lawyers and Business Services professionals

title: Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer partners with Legora to empower lawyers with advanced AI tools
summary: HSF Kramer announced adoption of Legora as its firmwide general-purpose AI platform, including a phased rollout of the client portal. The announcement says Legora adds to a technology stack already including Harvey, Relativity, Wexler.ai and Cicero.
evidenceQuote: The addition of Legora builds on the firm’s wider tech stack, which includes Harvey, Relativity, Wexler.ai, and Cicero.

title: Clifford Chance expands use of generative AI with deployment of Copilot for Microsoft 365 and Viva Suite for its global workforce
summary: Clifford Chance announced global deployment of Microsoft 365 Copilot and Viva Suite, following its own Clifford Chance Assist rollout. It says AI-generated legal output is identified and validated by a qualified lawyer in the relevant jurisdiction.
evidenceQuote: Any legal output generated at Clifford Chance by an AI system is identified as such and validated by a qualified lawyer in that jurisdiction.

title: Pinsent Masons forges strategic partnership with Legora
summary: Pinsent Masons announced a Legora partnership following a pilot in corporate, commercial and property. The announced rollout covered those teams globally, bringing users to 1,000, with pilots planned for remaining practice groups; it was not yet an all-practice rollout.
evidenceQuote: with pilots set to commence in all remaining practice groups

title: Browne Jacobson chooses Legora for firm-wide AI deployment
summary: Browne Jacobson announced the purchase of an enterprise-wide Legora licence after evaluating multiple legal AI products. Its pilot covered use cases across the firm's service lines and sectors.
evidenceQuote: Browne Jacobson has announced the purchase of an enterprise-wide licence for Legora
